47942:129512.description:
Label Medium is the medium label size, and the most commonly used. 

Labels are used for displaying texts like primary label on buttons, applied to interactive components.

47942:129511.name: label/lrg
47942:129511.description:
Label Large is the largest label. 

Labels are used for displaying prominent texts like label on title buttons, applied to interactive components.
